resources.string: Keep what matters. Clear the rest.
Early development. KeepClear can\'t look at or delete anything yet.
Junk you won\'t miss, cleaned in one tap. Everything waits 30 days in the trash.
Things that might matter, explained in plain words. You decide.
Your memories go to your own drive and are checked before anything is deleted.
No ads. No tracking. No internet access.
To look at your photos, videos and files, KeepClear needs your permission. Everything stays on this phone.
To find screenshots, big videos and what can be backed up.
Nothing leaves your phone unless you move it to a drive you choose.
Without it: only junk and app caches.
Finds WhatsApp media, folders left from your old phone, and other apps\' recycle bins.
Android still keeps other apps\' private data closed. KeepClear never deletes anything without asking you.
Without it: photos, videos and audio only.
Optional. Lets KeepClear find WhatsApp media, old-phone folders and recycle bins.
KeepClear sees only the photos you picked. Allow all to get real numbers.
Seeing photos, videos and audio only.
Scan stopped because access was removed. These numbers are incomplete.
Your phone is almost full. KeepClear is using as little space as possible.
Less than 100 MB left. KeepClear isn\'t saving anything until there\'s more room.
